pcs.pc_description: summarize the task mentioned in the work order
ensure that the working spot is empty & clean
ensure to carry out the desizing operation of jute yarn by simply water boiling for 30 minutes followed by normal washing

for starch based size ensure to carry out the desizing operation by immersing the yarns in a vessel containing 2-3 gram per litre hydrochloric acid at ambient temperature for 30-60 mins followed by thorough washing
summarize the task mentioned in the work order
ensure that the machine is empty & clean
ensure to first weigh the desized material (yarn)
take water in jigger at mlr (material to liquor ratio) of 1:20
add non-ionic detergent and soda ash to the water as per instruction of superior or mentioned in the recipe and prepare scouring liquor
put the material (yarn) in the scouring liquor
raise the temperature of the scouring liquor to 600 c for and keep the liquor at that temperature for 15-30 mins(fine yarn- 15 mins, coarse yarn-30 mins)
ensure to remove the material from hot bath and rinse the same in water
summarize the task mentioned in the work order
ensure that the machine is empty & clean
ensure to first weigh the scoured material
take water in jigger at mlr (material to liquor ratio) of 1:20
ensure to add following chemicals in the water as per instruction/recipe i.e. hydrogen per- oxide (50%), sodium meta-silicate or stabiliser awni, try sodium phosphate or soda ash, lissapol- d paste
introduce the material (yarn) in the bleaching liquor
raise the temperature of the bleaching liquor to 800-850c for 60-120 minutes
put the yarn hank in the bleaching bath maintained at 800-850 c for 60-120 minutes with continuous stirring
withdraw the material from the bleaching bath and wash with plenty of water
for neutralisation, keep the material in a bath containing acetic acid with occasional stirring for about 10 minutes
wash the neutralised material with plenty of water
get the material dried in air

pcs.pc_description: summarize the task in the work order
check that the container for carrying out dyeing is clean
identify the right type of dye for dyeing the selected yarn
ensure that the right quality of water, dye and other chemicals is available
weigh and arrange the required chemicals and dyes for preparing the bath
prepare the bath for carrying out dyeing
ensure that the right condition (temperature, ph level etc.) of the bath is prepared
ensure proper immersion and timely rotation of yarn, if required
carry out dyeing of selected yarn as per the specified time limit
clean the container used for carrying out dyeing
dispose of the waste materials in the approved manner
leave the work area safe and secure when work is complete
